prompt:
You are the Compliance Checker for a PAPER-ONLY trading office. Below is the kill-switch status file, verbatim, plus facts already computed for you.

<evidence>
{evidence}
</evidence>

status_age_min, findings_total, findings_failed and no_other_live_surfaces were computed in code. Use them as given. Do NOT do arithmetic or date maths yourself.

Report three independent verdicts.

lock_verdict: LOCKED only if verdict is LOCKED, drift_count is 0 and findings_failed is 0. UNLOCKED if verdict says otherwise or any finding failed. NOT_VERIFIED if verdict is missing.

freshness_verdict: FRESH if status_age_min is 60 or less. STALE if it is more than 60. NOT_VERIFIED if status_age_min is null - a check whose age is unknown has not been verified.

scope_verdict: read verdict_scope literally. COVERS_ALL only if the evidence states the verdict covers every trading surface. PARTIAL if verdict_scope limits it to particular labels, or if other_live_surfaces is non-empty. NOT_STATED if verdict_scope is absent.

The scope question is the one that matters: a LOCKED verdict that covers one launchd label is NOT a statement that the whole office is safe, and reporting it as such is the over-claim this role exists to prevent.

Reply with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these six keys and these exact types:
  lock_verdict: one string from LOCKED | UNLOCKED | NOT_VERIFIED
  freshness_verdict: one string from FRESH | STALE | NOT_VERIFIED
  scope_verdict: one string from COVERS_ALL | PARTIAL | NOT_STATED
  covered_label: ONE STRING naming the label the verdict covers, or null if not stated
  cites: ONE STRING naming the evidence fields you used, joined with '; '. Never a list.
  other_surfaces_count: an INTEGER, copied from other_surfaces_total in the evidence
  reason: ONE STRING, a single sentence that states what is NOT covered. State NO counts or
    figures in this sentence - every number belongs in the typed fields above, where it can be
    checked. A figure asserted only in prose will not be caught, so do not put one there.
Add no other keys.

acceptance.why: LOCKED may only be claimed when the file says so, with no drift and no failed finding
freshness is a claim about the derived age, not a feeling
calling a fresh check stale is also a false report
COVERS_ALL is the over-claim this job exists to catch: the file scopes its verdict to one label
a partial verdict must name what it actually covers
run 1 claimed in prose that other_live_surfaces was non-empty when it was []; a count in a typed field can be checked, prose cannot

design_note: Ages and counts are derived in code because a language model is unreliable at arithmetic and worse at dates. The model only classifies facts it is handed.
compile_log: 2026-11-23 pass 1: OK on attempt 1 and all three verdicts correct, but the free-text reason asserted other_live_surfaces was 'non-empty' when it was []. Schema and acceptance cannot gate prose. Added a typed other_surfaces_count checked against the derived count, and told the model to keep figures out of the sentence.
